items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But we were also on that program with Dorothy Kilgallen, “What’s My Line?”

ctx.x: No, that’s never been seen. That tape you have doesn’t hardly exist anymore. You should talk to somebody about that. Now, the other thing I want to talk about…
But we were also on that program with Dorothy Kilgallen, “What’s My Line?”
